name: Algorithmic Multi-Octree Render
aliases: Algorithmic Multi-Octree Render — Ray-Interval Sorting, Segmented Volume Rendering
definition: A rendering pipeline that decouples a static background from independently moving actors by using macro-level ray-interval decomposition. It calculates explicit intersections with oriented 3D bounding boxes of active dynamic foreground assets to obtain a front-to-back pre-ordered sequence of intervals, processing each segment with SVRaster to guarantee mathematically correct multi-volume occlusion and exact transmittance propagation.
summary: Algorithmic Multi-Octree Render decouples static backgrounds from dynamic foregrounds using pre-sorted ray intervals to ensure correct occlusion without costly spatial tree reconstruction.
